verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents user-directed region placement ('we run them where you tell us to', control over every Machine's region placement) and running close to users via Anycast. Nothing in the evidence describes the platform automatically placing compute near backend data. Manual region choice and user-proximity routing are adjacent capabilities, not the automatic data-proximate placement this story asks for.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
